source.title: Google Chrome Help: Browse in Incognito mode

leftSemantics.entity: Physical bookmark inserted in a printed book
leftSemantics.relation: marks a reader-selected place to resume reading

rightSemantics.relation: question asks whether they are deleted after Incognito
rightSemantics.value: saved site shortcuts persist in regular Chrome sessions

crossTopicRelevantPairs.leftToRightAssessment: The printed-book bookmark is a movable reading marker; the Chrome distractor concerns saved browser shortcuts and whether they are removed after an Incognito session. Same label, different entity/action/value/context.
crossTopicRelevantPairs.rightToLeftAssessment: A browser bookmark is not inserted into a book and does not mark its print-reading position. Candidate 83 explicitly says physical object and printed-book context; no duplicate fact.
